text_block_list.text:
The day before the race. While running in my racing silks
to do my final adjustments in the real race environment,
I happened to bump into some fans visiting from Japan.

text_block_list.name: Fan from Japan A
text_block_list.text: —I'll be cheering for you in tomorrow's race! Please, please, bring home Japan's first victory...!

text_block_list.name: Fan from Japan B
text_block_list.text:
Please show the world just how incredible Japanese Umamusume are.
Fulfill the racing world's long-cherished dream, I beg of you...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: No need to even ask.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: My victory is inevitable.

The fans buzz with anticipation and excitement.
Realizing once again that the prestige of Japan rests on this, I held my breath.

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Training in Racewear...
Great minds think alike. Plenty motivated, aren't we?"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
—Bonsoir!
Orfevre and Trainer.

The one who appeared was Venus Park.
As France's representative Umamusume,
she's the prime favorite to win tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
I saw your run earlier.
It was wonder, ful.

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
Now that makes beating you worthwhile.
This looks like it'll be a lot of fun!

Unshakeable confidence oozed from her.
I almost froze on the spot.
If I fail to win, the entire nation will be crushed.

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like you all have plenty of love from fans, too.
And the fierté of your countries... your 'pride.'"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A nation's pride...?
—No.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall bring glory to this nation.
As the supreme land that bore and nurtured this King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Do you not understand?
The history and knowledge accumulated by the Japanese racing world...
All of it is an offering.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: To me, who will win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: ...You think winning was a given?

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Je vois. So this is the 'Tyrant', is it?
However, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe won't be so easy!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious? What I desire are the things of the heavens in their entirety.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because it is precious,
it is worthy of my grasp—!

Orfevre is the "King."
A King who reigns supreme over Japan, and the world.
That's why...!
choice_data_list: Orfevre is definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Oui.
I understand your confidence.

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
That is why I will not lose!
I shall show you the strength of France.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well, work hard tomorrow.
Become the bedrock of my reign.
